question: Does cluster-disappearance occur over 30 multi-step threading iterations on slow seed 89 with an omega_max=0.5 dps (~2x truth) budget?
hypothesis: Brightness + connectability filtering kills inconsistent clusters over multi-step threading.
narrative_md: 30-step threading each direction on slow seed 89 with omega_max=0.5 dps (~2x truth |omega|=0.24). All 5 anchor clusters retain descendants through 30 steps in both directions -- NO cluster-disappearance. Brightness filtering does real work at some epochs (step 9 right kills 95.5%) but per-cluster contributions are even. Cluster-disappearance does not occur on slow seeds with a 2x-truth budget; the filter is too generous when omega_max is a multiple of truth |omega|. Tracks truth-cluster distance (truth read as input).
